## Validity Checks: Surveillance Index

### Population Normalisation

```{r}
# Raw index
cat("Raw index correlation", cor(analysis_df$raw_weighted_index, analysis_df$total_pop, use = "complete.obs"), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Per-100k index
cat("Per 100k index correlation", cor(analysis_df$weighted_index_per100k, analysis_df$total_pop, use = "complete.obs"), "\n")
```

```{r}
cat("Logged per 100k index correlation", cor(analysis_df$weighted_index_per100k, log(analysis_df$total_pop), use = "complete.obs"), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Graph
population_check_plot <- analysis_df |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_pop, y = weighted_index_per100k)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  labs(
    title = "Check: does per-100k index still depend on population?",
    x = "Total population (log scale)",
    y = "Surveillance index per 100k"
  ) +
  theme_thesis(base_size = figure_base_size)

save_figure(population_check_plot, "population_dependence_check.png", width = 9, height = 6)
```

```{r}
population_check_plot
```

```{r}
# Table of top weighted indices
analysis_df |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(!is.na(weighted_index_per100k), weighted_index_per100k > 0) |>
  mutate(implied_raw = round(weighted_index_per100k * total_pop / 100000)) |>
  arrange(desc(weighted_index_per100k)) |>
  select(NAME, total_pop, implied_raw, raw_weighted_index, weighted_index_per100k) |>
  slice_head(n = 30)
```

```{r}
# Plot of top scoring counties 
top20 <- analysis_df |>
  filter(!is.na(weighted_index_per100k)) |>
  arrange(desc(weighted_index_per100k)) |>
  slice_head(n = 30)

county_base <- analysis_df |>
  filter(!str_detect(GEOID, "^02|^15|^72"))   # drop AK, HI, PR for a cleaner continental view

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = county_base, fill = "grey92", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_sf(data = top20 |> filter(!str_detect(GEOID, "^02|^15|^72")),
          fill = "#d73027", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title    = "Top 30 counties by surveillance index per 100,000 population",
    caption  = "Source: Atlas of Surveillance · ACS 2024 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, colour = "grey30"),
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 7, colour = "grey50")
  )
```

```{r}
validity_comparison <- tibble(
  metric = c("Raw index vs. population (r)",
             "Per-100k index vs. population (r)",
             "Per-100k index vs. log(population) (r)"),
  full_sample = c(
    cor(analysis_df$raw_weighted_index, analysis_df$total_pop, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(analysis_df$weighted_index_per100k, analysis_df$total_pop, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(analysis_df$weighted_index_per100k, log(analysis_df$total_pop), use = "complete.obs")
  ),
  threshold_2500 = c(
    cor(analysis_df_2500$raw_weighted_index, analysis_df_2500$total_pop, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(analysis_df_2500$weighted_index_per100k, analysis_df_2500$total_pop, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(analysis_df_2500$weighted_index_per100k, log(analysis_df_2500$total_pop), use = "complete.obs")
  ),
  threshold_5000 = c(
    cor(analysis_df_5000$raw_weighted_index, analysis_df_5000$total_pop, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(analysis_df_5000$weighted_index_per100k, analysis_df_5000$total_pop, use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(analysis_df_5000$weighted_index_per100k, log(analysis_df_5000$total_pop), use = "complete.obs")
  )
) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))

validity_comparison
```

### Weight Sensitivity

```{r}
# Alternative 1: equal weighting for every technology (removes the weighting scheme)
tech_weights_equal <- tech_weights |> mutate(weight = 1)

# Alternative 2: perturb original weights randomly by ±0.25
set.seed(11)
tech_weights_perturbed_small <- tech_weights |>
  mutate(weight = pmax(1, weight + sample(c(-0.25, 0, 0.25), n(), replace = TRUE)))

# Alternative 3: perturb original weights randomly by ±0.5
set.seed(11)
tech_weights_perturbed_large <- tech_weights |>
  mutate(weight = pmax(1, weight + sample(c(-0.5, 0, 0.5), n(), replace = TRUE)))

# Recompute index under each alternative weighting scheme
recompute_index <- function(weights_table) {
  atlas_clean |>
    mutate(
      county_clean = str_to_title(
        str_remove(county,
          regex(" County$| Parish$| Borough$| City And Borough$| Census Area$| Municipality$| Municipio$| Municipality County$| Island$",
                ignore_case = TRUE))
      )
    ) |>
    left_join(fips_xwalk, by = c("state" = "state_name", "county_clean" = "county_name")) |>
    left_join(weights_table, by = "technology") |>
    mutate(weight = replace_na(weight, 1)) |>
    filter(!is.na(GEOID)) |>
    group_by(GEOID) |>
    summarise(alt_raw_index = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# Compare rankings: Spearman rank correlation between original and alternative indices
comparison <- analysis_df |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(GEOID, total_pop, weighted_index_per100k) |>
  left_join(recompute_index(tech_weights_equal), by = "GEOID") |>
  mutate(index_equal_per100k = replace_na(alt_raw_index, 0) / total_pop * 100000) |>
  select(-alt_raw_index) |>
  left_join(recompute_index(tech_weights_perturbed_small), by = "GEOID") |>
  mutate(index_perturbed_small_per100k = replace_na(alt_raw_index, 0) / total_pop * 100000) |>
  select(-alt_raw_index) |>
  left_join(recompute_index(tech_weights_perturbed_large), by = "GEOID") |>
  mutate(index_perturbed_large_per100k = replace_na(alt_raw_index, 0) / total_pop * 100000) |>
  select(-alt_raw_index)

cat("Spearman rank correlation between original and equal weights:",
    cor(comparison$weighted_index_per100k, comparison$index_equal_per100k,
        method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), "\n")
```

```{r}
cat("Spearman rank correlation between original and perturbed weights (±0.25):",
    cor(comparison$weighted_index_per100k, comparison$index_perturbed_small_per100k,
        method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), "\n")
```

```{r}
cat("Spearman rank correlation between original and perturbed weights (±0.5):",
    cor(comparison$weighted_index_per100k, comparison$index_perturbed_large_per100k,
        method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), "\n")
```

```{r}
analysis_df |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(weighted_index_per100k, n_records, n_agencies, n_tech_types) |>
  drop_na() |>
  cor(method = "spearman")
```

### Coverage-Cofound Check

```{r}
check5_data <- analysis_df |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(state = str_extract(NAME, "(?<=, ).*$")) |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarise(mean_index = mean(weighted_index_per100k, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(state_coverage |> select(state, pct_coverage), by = "state")

# Correlation
cat("Spearman correlation", 
    cor(check5_data$pct_coverage, check5_data$mean_index, 
        method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Plot
ggplot(check5_data, aes(x = pct_coverage, y = mean_index)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  labs(title = "Does mean county index track Atlas documentation coverage by state?",
       x = "% of counties in state with any Atlas record", y = "Mean surveillance index")
```
